name: H&MO (Housing & Maintenance Office)
overview: A government official Petrovich is tasked with relocating the residents of a dilapidated apartment building. As he goes from apartment to apartment, he encounters various residents: an old woman with pigeons, a mother with many children, a teenager on the roof, and a soldier with a fragile psyche. With each new door and the story behind it, a new personality subtly develops within the protagonist. An experimental mini-series released in a format of Instagram-reels.
